title: Unique Deal | CreativeFitting Raises Baidu Pre-A+; Unique Capital Advises
summary: Global first AI short-drama app Reel.AI launched overseas and quickly climbed entertainment paid charts — another breakout GenAI consumer product. Its maker, CreativeFitting (井英科技), has drawn investor attention.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Unique Deal · July 4, 2024

Global first AI short-drama app Reel.AI launched overseas and quickly climbed entertainment paid charts — another breakout GenAI consumer product. Its maker, CreativeFitting (井英科技), has drawn investor attention.

CreativeFitting closed a multi-million USD Pre-A+ round from Baidu Group, with Unique Capital as financial advisor for the round — another Baidu bet on AI-native applications.

Team

Among the earliest China teams exploring LLM video generation, CreativeFitting mixes AI depth with content craft. Founder & CEO Zhu Jiang (SJTU CS) was CGO at TouchPal, building entertainment apps with tens of millions of DAU and leading global growth.

As GenAI moves from single- to multimodal and some scenes hit consumable quality, new AIGC killer-app openings appear in immersive interactive entertainment.

Reel.AI — AI-native short drama hits hard

Reel.AI combines AI short dramas with AI interactive experience. Launched overseas on December 28, 2023, it became a flagship AI-native case. Users began topping up within four days despite a thin catalog; paying users kept growing.

Android currently carries 19 short dramas: 15 live-action, 4 AIGC (two anime, two Western-style). Micro-expressions, micro-motions, and lip sync are coherent; scripts and emotion read as real.

Growth rests on CreativeFitting’s self-developed Reel Diffusion narrative video tools — tuned for emotionally resonant shorts via algorithms, training data, and engineering so creators can tell better stories.

At a recent global AI film marathon, CreativeFitting partnered with director Jud Willmont (吴剑) on AI short M.A.D., winning the Bilibili Audience Choice Award — a nod to Reel Diffusion and human–AI co-creation.

AI + entertainment: the inflection

GenAI stretches experience from vision/audio/writing/dialogue to real-time, personalized generation and immersive interaction. Short-drama production today is still AI + human: external directors write and break scripts into storyboards → prompts into the model → model replaces traditional performance for shot generation → directors pick or re-prompt → post in pro tools. Philosophy: humans own creative potential; AI owns specialized generation.

Zhu: “Progress is driven by application scenes. Research still races for frontier base models, but attention is shifting to which AI-native apps become super apps.” On Baidu: “An endorsement of the team and product — and of AI-native application prospects.”

Proceeds will iterate video models/tools, strengthen the content ecosystem, and accelerate Reel.AI’s lead in AI + entertainment.

4 CN images; attach on ingest.

— END —
